title: Rory and the Starry Lantern Cove
verses:
The quiet night was shining blue,
Above the cozy hill,
The leaves were soft with silver dew,
And all the woods were still.

Then Rory walked along the track,
Beside the resting trees,
With Benny close behind his back,
Beneath the evening breeze.

Now Tilly found a cozy mound,
Where glowing blossoms peep,
And Psittaco was safe and sound,
And ready for his sleep.

Across the sky did Nia glide,
To watch the silver moon,
While Ricky curled up by her side,
To hear a quiet tune.

They nestled down upon the moss,
So safe and tucked in tight,
A gentle shadow rolled across,
The sleepy summer night.

Now Rory closed his tired eyes,
And gave a happy sigh,
Beneath the warm and starry skies,
As night went drifting by.
